title: FizzBuzz from 1 to 20
prompt: Print the numbers from 1 to 20 (inclusive), one per line, with these replacements: print `FizzBuzz` instead of the number when it is divisible by both 3 and 5, `Fizz` when it is divisible by 3 (but not by 5), and `Buzz` when it is divisible by 5 (but not by 3). Use exactly this spelling and capitalization.
expected_output:
1
2
Fizz
4
Buzz
Fizz
7
8
Fizz
Buzz
11
Fizz
13
14
FizzBuzz
16
17
Fizz
19
Buzz
